claims.quote: Boraras merah is a miniature cyprinid from southern Borneo, described from the Jelai Bila river basin near Sukamara in Central Kalimantan, Indonesia.
Boraras merah is native to the peat swamp forests and slow-moving blackwater streams of Borneo and parts of Sumatra (Indonesia).

The type specimens were collected from the Jelai Bila river basin at Nataik Sedawak, presumably a settlement of some kind, near the town of Sukamara in the Indonesian province of Kalimantan Tengah (Central Kalimantan).
